description: Abstract class ResourceTypeClassBase for managing Android resource type classes, including building resource fields and caching field data.

classes.name: ResourceTypeClassBase
classes.description: Abstract class extending AndroidLightClass, providing methods to build resource fields and cache them.

methods.name: buildResourceFields
methods.description: Static method to generate resource fields based on resource manager data, resource class name, and context.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns cached array of PsiField objects representing resource fields.

methods.name: doGetFields
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to provide specific field retrieval logic.
